messages:
jess: hey team, quick question — where should I post requests for laptop VPN access and GCP project invites? new hire checklist says 'ask infra' but wasn't sure which channel or template to use

onboarding-bot: hi @jess — welcome! please ping @devops in #eng-infra for VPN + infra access. also fill the Access Request form: https://redwood.internal/access-request (link only works on VPN)

mike_l: @jess +1 to #eng-infra. if you need faster help DM @devops with this info: name, employee ID, role, required projects. keeps the ticket small

lina: tagging policy — for project invites use the short template so grantors know envs: 

```
Subject: Access request — Jess D (ID: 4291)
Resources: project-redwood-prod, billing-view
Reason: onboarding — backend engineer, needs deploy access for dev env
Urgency: standard
```

works well for us, saves follow-ups

sam: FWIW, if you need SSH keys added to jumpbox: post in #eng-infra with the key, but prefix message with `[SSH KEY]` and don't paste passphrases. We rotate keys nightly so include expiration date if temporary

jess: thanks — where do I request bot invites? e.g., calendar bot and the CI bot to my DMs

mike_l: calendar bot invite = DM @onboarding-bot with `add calendar @jess` (it auto-invites based on email). CI bot (ci-notify) needs team-level invite — ask in #eng-devops and cc your manager. small note: don't add bot accounts to private channels without a ticket

lina: also etiquette: keep access requests in #eng-infra (public) unless details are sensitive — we create internal ticket and move sensitive stuff to private thread. Avoid multiple DMs to different infra folks, that blocks triage

jess: got it. last one: who to cc for hardware (extra monitor) and software licenses?

devops: hardware = @ops-requests in #help (use the "New Hardware" template). software licenses = ping @procurement and cc your manager. proc runs weekly so mark as urgent if needed earlier

sam: small tip — use emoji reactions instead of follow-up posts when you're just acknowledging a resolved request (:white_check_mark:). keeps the channel readable

jess: perfect thanks everyone! starting checklist now. :rocket:
